messages:
marta: Quick catch on PR #4930  the API reference shows camelCase in raw JSON for /v1/generate. People copying the curl/js examples hit 400s.
ishan: Confirming: raw REST examples must use snake_case (e.g., max_new_tokens). SDK samples remain camelCase.
prashant: I'll patch openapi/generated.yml. Also noticed the streaming example only had message.role; need message.content array so SSE parsers don't blow up.
olivia: I'll update the language snippets (JS/cURL/python) to use snake_case and add a tiny SSE parsing snippet that expects message.content[0].text.
ryan: I'll add a docs test to validate OpenAPI examples against the response schema so CI fails on regressions.
doc-bot: CI: preview built for branch fix-4930 -> https://staging-docs.redwood.ai/preview/4930 (lint OK)
marta: Example to replace:

```js
// incorrect (raw API in PR)
fetch('/v1/generate', { body: JSON.stringify({ model: 'redwood-1', prompt: 'hi', maxNewTokens: 32 }) })
```

Replace with raw-API (snake_case) + SSE note:

```js
// raw API body
fetch('/v1/generate', { body: JSON.stringify({ model: 'redwood-1', prompt: 'hi', max_new_tokens: 32, stream: true }) })

// SSE chunk expected shape:
// { message: { role: 'assistant', content: [{ type: 'output_text', text: '...' }] } }
```

marta: Once preview looks good I'll add a one-line changelog clarifying API vs SDK naming. Thanks!
